visualContract.layoutPolicy: The actual source pre/code/line hierarchy and public wrap/lineNumbers/startLine semantics lead the recipe. Native 18px surface corners,16px section/content insets and 8px header gap remain semantic metrics; source 448px example widths are never fixed. Actual native text runs and line-number text specify Geist Mono Medium 14/20, despite a22.75px artwork row frame; the pinned supplied font follows those text values. Compact 12/16 and 28rem maximum scroll height are explicit reference decisions. Native unbound highlighted zinc at50% is retained for light mode, with an explicit 10% light foreground tint in dark mode for readable text; added-line colors and destructive inset stroke are explicit visual decisions because pinned wrapper classes define the variants without these scalar values. The visible +/− text and legend carry diff meaning independently of color. Code content remains LTR inside RTL hosts. Counter-only line numbers have empty speech alternative where supported, and Copy always uses the caller value rather than rendered numbers or diff DOM. Headerless actions reveal on hover, focus-within and coarse pointers; the real native Button remains independently reachable. Copy success,2000ms reset and swallowed rejection remain actual source behavior; persistent selection instructions provide the concrete fallback. Root never executes code or adds a syntax highlighter.
